items.source: Builder for AOT repository fragment classes.
items.translation: AOT 存储库片段类的构建器。

items.source: Customizer interface to customize the AOT repository fragment class after it has been defined.
items.translation: 自定义器界面，用于在定义 AOT 存储库片段类后进行自定义。

items.source: Add a class customizer. Customizer is invoked after building the class.
items.translation: 添加一个类定制器。该定制器在构建类之后被调用。

items.source: customizer - the customizer with direct access to the type builder.
items.translation: customizer - 可直接访问 type builder 的自定义器。
